idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Work with Kubernetes clusters from inside PyCharm using kubectl, helm and terraform.
  • Add, import, switch and remove kubeconfig contexts
  • Deploy YAML manifests to the current context (editor / project view context menu, or the tool window)
  • Create a context from a Terraform output (cluster endpoint, CA, name)
  • Search Artifact Hub and install Helm charts into the current context

action.text: Deploy YAML to Current Kubernetes Context
action.description: Runs kubectl apply -f on the selected YAML file(s) against the current context
